# MightyPaint

> MightyPaint is a comprehensive color and design toolkit offering free tools for color selection, accessibility testing, and interior design guidance.

MightyPaint combines interactive color tools (palette generators, color pickers, contrast checkers) with educational design guides for both digital designers and home decorators. The platform emphasizes accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1) and provides practical resources for paint selection and interior styling.

## Key Topics

- Color Palette Generator
- Color Blindness Simulator
- Paint Color Selection
- HEX/CSS/RGB Color Formats
- Contrast Checker
- WCAG Accessibility
- Color Blindness (CVD)
- Interior Design
- Shade & Tint Generator
- Color Sampler Tool
- Home Styling
- Design Tools
- Fail-Safe Paint Color Playbook
- Inclusive Design
- Free Design Resources

## Color Tools & Generators

- [Shade & Tint Generator](https://mightypaint.com/shade-amp-tint-generator): Free tool to generate CSS color palettes with shade and tint variations in HEX/HSL formats.
- [Interactive HTML Color Picker & HEX Code](https://mightypaint.com/interactive-html-color-picker-tool): Interactive HTML color picker generating HEX codes and CSS color values for design workflows.
- [Image Color Sampler Tool](https://mightypaint.com/image-color-sampler-tool): Color sampler tool to extract HEX codes from images for design inspiration and color matching.

## Accessibility & Design Testing

- [Color-Blindness Simulator](https://mightypaint.com/color-blindness-simulator): WCAG 2.1 compliant color blindness simulator for testing inclusive design and color vision deficiency accessibility.

## Design Guides & Resources

- [Free Design Guides & Playbooks](https://mightypaint.com/free-design-guides-playbooks): Hub for free design guides including Paint Color Playbook and Home Styling Bible.
- [Paint Color Playbook](https://mightypaint.com/paint-color-playbook): Fail-Safe Paint Color Playbook guide covering color selection, matching, and room lighting considerations.
- [Home Styling Bible](https://mightypaint.com/home-styling-bible): Interior design guide covering furniture placement, room layout, and home decor styling tips.

## Getting Started

- [Home - MightyPaint](https://mightypaint.com): MightyPaint homepage showcasing all color tools: palette generator, contrast checker, and color blindness simulator.
